name: Income Statement 2
definition: Statement of the financial performance of a legal entity, including identification of the clearing member.

ClearingMemberFee.name: Clearing Member Fee
ClearingMemberFee.definition: Specifies the clearing fees recorded in month-end management reporting for the financial year-to-date.

OtherOperatingRevenue.name: Other Operating Revenue
OtherOperatingRevenue.definition: Other operating revenue recorded in month-end management reporting for the financial year-to-date.

OperatingExpenses.name: Operating Expenses
OperatingExpenses.definition: Operating expenses recorded in month-end management reporting for the financial year-to-date.

OperatingProfitOrLoss.name: Operating Profit Or Loss
OperatingProfitOrLoss.definition: Indicates the operating profit (true) or loss (false) recorded in the month-end management reporting for the financial year-to-date.

NetInterestIncome.name: Net Interest Income
NetInterestIncome.definition: Net interest income recorded in month-end management reporting for the financial year-to-date.

OtherNonOperatingRevenue.name: Other Non Operating Revenue
OtherNonOperatingRevenue.definition: Other non-operating revenue recorded in month-end management reporting for the financial year-to-date.

NonOperatingExpenses.name: Non Operating Expenses
NonOperatingExpenses.definition: Non-operating expenses recorded in month-end management reporting for the financial year-to-date.

PreTaxProfitOrLoss.name: Pre Tax Profit Or Loss
PreTaxProfitOrLoss.definition: Indicates the pre-tax profit (true) or loss (false) recorded in month-end management reporting for the financial year-to-date.

PostTaxProfitOrLoss.name: Post Tax Profit Or Loss
PostTaxProfitOrLoss.definition: Indicates the post-tax profit (true) or loss (false) recorded in month-end management reporting for the financial year-to-date.
